c: You wake on a cold, dark floor, your head pounding. Your own name is the only thing you can remember.
Seven others share the room with you - strangers, frightened, breathing.
By the dim ceiling lights you make out a heavy metal door marked 9, and four small rooms along the walls, each signed 'Voting Room'.
A megaphone shrieks to life. A calm voice welcomes you to Vault 9 and says none of you will leave until the Nonary Game has been played.
Then, patiently, the voice begins to explain the rules...
r: - Everyone begins the game with 3 points.
- Each round you are paired with another prisoner. In secret you each vote to ALLY or BETRAY, and the votes are revealed together.
- Reach a minimum of 9 points to open the Number 9 Door; everyone with 9 or more escapes when it opens.
- The door opens only once. Anyone below 9 points is sealed inside the vault forever.
- If you fall to 0 points, you are executed.
- There is no limit to the rounds; the game ends the moment the door opens.
b: Cold calculator. Blocks your escape and seizes wins; rarely emotional.
Out for himself. Betrays often and loves stealing points.
Deeply suspicious. Cross him once and he stops trusting you.
Wants to trust everyone, but is easily swayed and erratic.
Gentle to a fault. Allies almost always, even at a cost.
Runs on nerves. Safe = ally; cornered or wronged = anything.
Fair but firm. Trust for trust, betrayal for betrayal.
Principled. Never betrays first, but answers in kind.
